q.description: Search query, matched against the alias and alt text.

repo.description: Restrict results to a single repo's collection. Network-wide search when omitted.

main.description: Search Bluemoji by alias or alt text. Searches network-wide by default (subject to takedown filtering) — pass 'repo' to restrict to a single repo's own collection, e.g. for a composer picker limited to the signed-in user's emoji. Intended as shared infrastructure so clients don't need to maintain their own emoji search index for :-autocomplete pickers.
